title: TF module: VPC audit logging orchestration with retention lifecycle and upgrade hooks
creator: Alexandra Kim
description: Implement a reusable Terraform module to orchestrate VPC audit logging for Private deployments. The module will: (1) provision cross-account CloudTrail with Lakehouse-style organization (primary audit account + regional log buckets), (2) configure S3 lifecycle policies for staged retention (hot -> warm -> archive/Glacier), (3) wire up OpenSearch (managed or self-hosted) ingestion pipelines with ILM policies and index rollover, (4) expose health-check endpoints and alerting hooks for missing CloudTrail files or failed ingestion, and (5) provide upgrade hooks for schema changes (index template migrations) and safe rollback paths. Goal is to standardize onboarding for customer VPCs, reduce configuration drift, and make retention policies auditable and reversible.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module published to internal registry with semantic versioning and README
Module deploys CloudTrail across accounts with least-privilege IAM roles and automatic S3 bucket encryption/KMS integration
S3 lifecycle policies implemented: 90d hot -> 365d warm -> 7y archive (Glacier) with tagging-driven transitions configurable
OpenSearch ingestion pipeline created with ILM policy and index rollover; sample index created within deployment
Health checks: Lambda or containerized probe reports ingestion lag, missing manifests, and S3 permission errors to Sentry and Ops channel
Upgrade path documented and automated: index template migration terraform plan + dry-run flag, with canary index support
E2E test run in staging using synthetic CloudTrail records succeeds and alerting triggers on injected failure
Security review completed and sign-off recorded in Confluence
implementation_steps: Draft module interface: variables, outputs, and defaults (regional vs centralized ops)
Prototype cross-account CloudTrail and S3 layout in staging account
Implement S3 lifecycle and KMS + bucket policy automation
Build OpenSearch ingest modules: pipeline template, ILM, index template management
Add healthcheck lambda/container and Alertmanager/SNS integration
Create upgrade hook: terraform plan -> migration runner -> canary index -> cutover
Write automated integration tests and sample deployment guide
Open PR, run security review, merge and cut v0.1.0
comments: 2025-02-12 Alexandra Kim: Initial ticket created after design working session. Scope includes CloudTrail, S3 lifecycle, OpenSearch ILM, healthchecks, and upgrade hooks. Linked to ENG-30512 for backplane integration.

2025-02-18 Ravi Patel: Spike complete — prototype created in staging. Observations: cross-account role bootstrap needed for account onboarding; S3 lifecycle rules require explicit object tagging to avoid premature transition. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123
2025-02-22 Morgan Lee (Security): Reviewed IAM plans; requested least-privilege refinements and KMS key policy adjustments to ensure central audit account cannot be used to escalate privileges.

2025-02-25 Priya Desai (Observability): Suggested adding a manifest file parity check before ingestion and a metric for 'days-since-last-manifest' to detect failed delivery quickly. Added to healthchecks.

2025-02-28 Ravi Patel: Implemented ILM policy prototype and index rollover. Found that small clusters require shard tuning to avoid frequent rotation; added config knobs for shard count and index size threshold. Draft module README: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/VPC+Audit+Module

2025-03-03 Alexandra Kim: Security review checklist added and assigned to Morgan. Plan for staged rollout: enable in 2 internal test VPCs, monitor for 72h, then enable for new customer onboarding. Next: address token expiration in cross-account assume-role scripts and finalize PR comments.
healthcheck_plan: Deploy lightweight probe that validates: (1) new CloudTrail manifest files appear within expected window, (2) S3 object ACLs and KMS encryption are intact, (3) ingest pipeline ack exists in OpenSearch. Expose metrics to Prometheus and create PagerDuty escalation for 'ingest_failed' and 'manifest_missing_for_24h'.
migration_strategy: Provide an automated migration runner that creates a canary index using the new index template, replays a bounded sample of historical records for validation, then updates alias to point to new index on successful smoke tests. Terraform plan includes 'dry_run=true' option to generate migration steps without executing. Rollback is alias swap back to old index and revert index templates.
risks: Cross-account IAM misconfiguration could allow data access escalation — mitigated via security review and automated IAM linter
Large customer accounts may generate high index rollover churn — mitigated by configurable shard/size thresholds and rate-limiting ingest
S3 lifecycle transitions could inadvertently archive active files if tagging is misapplied — include safeguards and canary deployments before wide rollout
OpenSearch cluster capacity mismatch may cause ingestion lag — plan includes capacity recommendations and autoscaling knobs
